paraphrase: The Cuckoo of Awareness: the nature of variety is non-dual; each thing is free of elaboration; though not conceived as 'suchness', the all-good appears everywhere; being already complete, give up the sickness of effort; remaining spontaneously is the settling.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase). Wording checked through its occurrence as chapter 31 of the local Kunjed Gyalpo.
